methodology: Official council and Queensland Government sources only. A partner council official announcement is included for one separately marked announced MOU.

Relationship type is taken from the specific agreement description, with contradictory general summaries disclosed. Sister-city, sister-region, friendship, MOU, economic and other arrangements are kept distinct.

Listed on a current council page describes the available public evidence; councils should confirm present exchange opportunities. Signing years are omitted where not explicit or internally inconsistent.
An unsuccessful search or omission from a newer list is not treated as proof of non-existence or termination.
Country/territory wording follows source usage; Mackay labels Kailua Kona as Hawaii. Fraser Coast source misspelling is preserved separately.
limitations: No evidence of suspension or termination was established for these assigned councils. This is not proof that every historical relationship remains operational.
